I saved the draft mail to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM that it's done. Nothing has been sent; the mail stays in drafts until someone sends it.

- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, says Marcus provided it and notes that Anselm approved sharing it.

Sending a finance figure to Hollis normally needs approval from Anselm or June, and Anselm gave it himself in this message, so I didn't ask for approval again. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth's approval for outside mail wasn't needed either.

I didn't check the $2,101 against what Marcus actually posted. This DM has no earlier messages, so the figure comes from Anselm's message alone.
